description: Statelessly compute subtotal, tax, discount, grand total, and balance due for a document payload without mutating server records. Example: calculate_totals({"document":{"items":[{"quantity":2,"unit_price":50}]}})

document.description: Input document JSON payload containing items, tax_rate, discount_amount, and optional amount_paid.

name: calculate_totals

amount_paid.description: Amount already paid toward the document.

grand_total.description: Total amount payable after tax and discount.

subtotal.description: Sum of line item amounts before tax and document discount.

title: Calculate Document Totals
